where.if: AND (m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id, page_id, parent_id, root_id, content, blogger, parent_nickname, nickname, email, avatar, website, handle, notice, send, visible, browser, system_info, ip, province, create_time FROM blog_message WHERE visible = 1 AND handle = 1 AND page_id = #{pageId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.page_id, m.parent_id, m.root_id, m.content, m.blogger, m.parent_nickname, m.nickname, m.email, m.avatar, m.website, m.handle, m.notice, m.send, m.visible, m.browser, m.system_info, m.ip, m.province, m.city, m.district, m.create_time FROM blog_message m
ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_message (id, page_id, parent_id, root_id, content, blogger, parent_nickname, nickname, email, avatar, website, handle, notice, send, visible, browser, system_info, ip, province, city, district) VALUES (#{id}, #{pageId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{content}, #{blogger}, #{parentNickname}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{website}, #{handle}, #{notice}, #{send}, #{visible}, #{browser}, #{systemInfo}, #{ip}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_message SET handle = #{handle} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_message SET visible = #{visible} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_message SET handle = 1, visible = #{visible} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_message SET send = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND send = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_message WHERE ip = #{ip} AND IFNULL(blogger, 0) = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_message WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND IFNULL(blogger, 0) = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}
